about: The Zoloft taper history places the 20 May sodium of 125 mmol/L during treatment, with recovery to 137 mmol/L on 23 May.
Possible finding: the record holds no sodium result or low sodium line anywhere, although escitalopram (an SSRI) is supplied monthly.
The June 2025 low sodium resolved that month, and serum sodium was 130 mmol/L at the latest citalopram supply in April 2026.
